name: NORMIE
fix_description: In _transfer, remove the logic that adds amount to _balances[address(this)] when isMarketPair[sender] && premarket_user[recipient]. This creates tokens out of thin air - the full amount is credited to both the contract and the recipient, inflating total supply. The attacker exploits this by triggering swapAndLiquify with the inflated contract balance.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a multi-step attack involving an initial buy, a V2 flash swap, a V3 flash loan, router-based swaps, and repeated skim/transfer abuse against a fee-on-transfer token pair. While the exploit logic is not deeply protocol-internal, it requires understanding AMM pair accounting, flash loan callbacks, and the specific skim-loop mechanics, so it is more than a straightforward single-pattern bug.
